listen port: The HIS listen port on the app server stopped answering after the patch.
补丁之后，应用服务器上的 HIS 监听端口不再应答了。
open port: An open port on the lab printer is accepting connections from the whole ward.
实验室那台打印机上有一个开放端口，整间病区都能连上去。
closed port: That closed port is why the pharmacy client cannot reach the billing host.
那个端口是关着的，所以药房客户端连不上收费主机。
firewall rule: This firewall rule lets only the clinic subnet reach the lab interface.
这条防火墙规则只允许门诊子网访问检验接口。
NAT: NAT (Network Address Translation) hides every ward PC behind one public address.
NAT（网络地址转换）把每台病区电脑都藏在同一个公网地址后面。
port forward: The port forward sends vendor support straight to the PACS admin host.
这条端口转发把厂商支持直接送到 PACS 管理主机。
DMZ: DMZ (Demilitarized Zone) holds the patient portal so the ward LAN stays separate.
DMZ（隔离区）放着患者门户，病区局域网因此和它隔开。
intranet: Staff open the intranet for policies, but patients never see that site.
员工上内网查制度，患者看不到那个站点。
extranet: The extranet lets partner labs upload results without entering our core network.
外联网让合作检验所上传结果，而不进入我们的核心网。
internet breakout: All clinic browsing leaves through the east internet breakout during office hours.
上班时间，门诊上网流量都从东侧上网出口出去。
proxy bypass: A proxy bypass for the local PACS viewer keeps images from loading slowly.
本地 PACS 阅片端绕过代理之后，图像才不会加载得很慢。
PAC file: The PAC file sends clinic browsers to the proxy and skips local servers.
这份代理自动配置把门诊浏览器送到代理，并跳过本地服务器。
DNS cache: The DNS cache on this PC still points HIS to the old address.
这台电脑的域名缓存还把 HIS 指到旧地址。
flush DNS: Flush DNS on the registration PC before you retry the new HIS name.
在挂号电脑上先刷新域名缓存，再试新的 HIS 名称。
hosts file: Someone put a stale lab address in the hosts file on that counter PC.
有人在那台窗口电脑的主机映射文件里写了一个过期的检验地址。
CNAME: The CNAME (Canonical Name) for mail follows the new records server name.
邮件的 CNAME（别名记录）跟着新病历服务器的名称走。
A record: Change the A record so the portal name points at the new web host.
改掉地址记录，让门户名称指向新的网站主机。
MX record: The MX record must point at the hospital mail gateway, not the old relay.
邮件交换记录必须指向医院邮件网关，不能指向旧中继。
TTL: Lower the TTL (Time To Live) before we rename the lab server tonight.
今晚给检验服务器改名之前，先把 TTL（生存时间）调低。
DHCP reservation: The DHCP reservation keeps this anesthesia PC on the same address.
这条地址保留让这台麻醉电脑一直用同一个地址。
static IP: Give the infusion pump gateway a static IP so nurses can always find it.
给输液泵网关一个静态地址，护士才总能找到它。
dynamic IP: A dynamic IP on the label printer changed, and pharmacy lost the queue.
标签打印机的动态地址变了，药房打印队列就断了。
link down: Link down on the clinic closet switch cut off six registration PCs.
门诊弱电间交换机链路断开，六台挂号电脑跟着断了。
link up: Link up came back at 06:10, and the ward phones registered again.
链路在 06:10 恢复，病区电话又重新注册上了。
duplex mismatch: A duplex mismatch on the radiology uplink is dropping large image transfers.
放射上联口双工不匹配，大图像传输正在丢包。
speed mismatch: Speed mismatch between the phone and the switch port made calls choppy.
电话和交换机端口速率不匹配，通话就变得断断续续。
CRC error: CRC error counters climbed on the fiber to building C after the storm.
暴风雨之后，通往 C 座那根光纤上的校验错误计数一直在涨。
broadcast storm: A broadcast storm in the lobby VLAN slowed badge readers to a crawl.
大厅 VLAN 里的广播风暴把门禁读卡器拖得几乎没反应。
loop: A loop between two ward switches flooded every port with broadcasts.
两台病区交换机之间的环路把每个端口都灌满了广播。
spanning tree: Spanning tree blocked the extra link and stopped the clinic loop.
生成树堵住了多余的那条链路，门诊的环路就停了。
trunk: The trunk to the emergency building carries voice, badge, and guest VLANs.
通往急诊楼的中继链路承载语音、门禁和访客 VLAN。
access port: Set this access port to the nurse-call VLAN before the phone goes live.
电话启用前，把这个接入端口划到护士呼叫 VLAN。
uplink: The uplink from clinic closet two is saturated during morning registration.
二号门诊弱电间的上联口在早高峰挂号时已经打满。
core switch: The core switch in room A feeds every building, so we reboot it only at night.
A 机房的核心交换机供着每栋楼，所以我们只在夜里重启它。
distribution switch: The distribution switch for the west wing lost one power supply at noon.
西楼的汇聚交换机中午掉了一块电源。
access switch: Replace the access switch in treatment room four; half its ports are dead.
换掉四号治疗室的接入交换机，它有一半端口已经不通了。
stack: The stack in pharmacy closet lost the master after a short power dip.
药房弱电间的交换机堆叠在短暂停电后丢了主设备。
power supply: One power supply in the core switch failed, and the spare is already online.
核心交换机有一块电源模块坏了，备用的已经在线。
UPS: The UPS (Uninterruptible Power Supply) kept the core running through the ten-minute outage.
UPS（不间断电源）让核心设备撑过了那十分钟停电。
PDU: PDU (Power Distribution Unit) B in rack twelve tripped and dropped two hosts.
十二号机柜的 PDU（电源分配单元）B 跳闸，两台主机掉电了。
generator: The generator took the data hall load eight seconds after utility power failed.
市电中断八秒后，发电机接上了机房负载。
cooling: Cooling in row C fell behind, and inlet temperatures passed the alarm line.
C 列的机房制冷跟不上，进风温度过了告警线。
CRAC: CRAC (Computer Room Air Conditioner) two is offline, so row B is running warm.
二号 CRAC（机房空调）停了，B 列现在偏热。
raised floor: Lift the raised floor tile carefully; the fiber tray sits just underneath.
掀架空地板的地板砖时慢一点，光纤桥架就在正下面。
rack: Leave the bottom of this rack empty so the new storage array fits.
这个机柜底部先空着，新存储阵列才放得下。
U space: This rack has only two U space left, and the new array needs four.
这个机柜只剩两个机柜高度单位，新阵列却需要四个。
KVM: Use the KVM (Keyboard Video Mouse) in rack six to reach the host with no network.
用六号机柜的 KVM（键盘视频鼠标切换）去连那台没有网络的主机。
console cable: Bring a console cable; the switch lost its address and SSH will not answer.
带一根控制台线，这台交换机地址丢了，SSH 不会有应答。
serial console: The serial console still answers when the management network is down.
管理网断了的时候，串口控制台仍然能连。
IPMI: IPMI (Intelligent Platform Management Interface) lets us power-cycle the host from the office.
IPMI（服务器底板管理）让我们在办公室就能给主机断电再开机。
iLO: The iLO (Integrated Lights-Out) address is printed on the bezel of this ProLiant.
这台 ProLiant 的面板上印着 iLO（远程管理口）地址。
iDRAC: iDRAC (Integrated Dell Remote Access Controller) shows a failed fan on the lab host.
iDRAC（远程管理卡）显示实验室主机有一个风扇故障。
BMC: The BMC (Baseboard Management Controller) hung, so the remote console froze too.
BMC（基板管理控制器）卡死了，远程控制台也跟着冻住。
firmware update: Schedule the firmware update for the storage array after radiology closes.
等放射科下班，再安排存储阵列的固件更新。
BIOS update: The BIOS update fixes the memory error we saw on three identical hosts.
这次主板固件更新修好了三台相同主机上的内存报错。
driver pack: Install the new driver pack before you join these clinic PCs to the domain.
这些门诊电脑加域之前，先装上新的驱动包。
image: Capture a fresh image from the reference PC after the viewer is licensed.
阅片软件授权好之后，从参考电脑抓一份新的系统镜像。
golden image: The golden image already includes the badge driver and the ward print queue.
标准镜像里已经带了门禁驱动和病区打印队列。
PXE boot: PXE boot failed in clinic B because the DHCP helper was on the wrong VLAN.
门诊 B 的网络启动失败了，因为 DHCP 中继落在错误的 VLAN。
MDT: MDT (Microsoft Deployment Toolkit) builds the clinic image from the task sequence we saved.
MDT（批量部署工具）按我们保存的任务序列生成门诊镜像。
SCCM: SCCM (System Center Configuration Manager) is pushing the viewer to every reading room PC.
SCCM（系统中心配置管理）正在把阅片软件推到每台读片室电脑。
Intune: Intune enrolled the new ward tablets and applied the hospital Wi-Fi profile.
Intune 注册了新的病区平板，并套上了医院的 Wi-Fi 配置。
MDM: MDM (Mobile Device Management) can wipe a lost tablet without touching the SIM.
MDM（移动设备管理）可以清空丢失的平板，不用动 SIM 卡。
BYOD: BYOD (Bring Your Own Device) phones stay off the medical-record VLAN.
BYOD（自带设备）的手机不能进入病历 VLAN。
mobile device: Each mobile device on the ward must check in before it can open mail.
病区每台移动设备都要先登记，才能打开邮件。
tablet: The tablet at bed twelve lost the ward Wi-Fi and cannot chart meds.
十二床的平板掉了病区无线，没法录入用药。
smartphone: A personal smartphone on the guest SSID cannot reach the lab system.
连在访客无线上的个人智能手机进不了检验系统。
pager: The night engineer still wears a pager because the basement blocks cell signal.
夜班工程师还带着传呼机，因为地下室没有手机信号。
VoIP: VoIP (Voice over Internet Protocol) phones in the ICU reboot if the voice VLAN flaps.
语音 VLAN 一抖动，ICU 的 VoIP（网络电话）就会重启。
SIP: SIP (Session Initiation Protocol) registration failed, so the nurse desk phone stays unregistered.
SIP（会话启动协议）注册失败，护士站电话一直挂在未注册。
PBX: The PBX (Private Branch Exchange) routes emergency calls out the analog trunks first.
PBX（程控交换机）会先把急救电话从模拟中继送出去。
softphone: The softphone on her laptop drops when the clinic Wi-Fi changes access points.
门诊 Wi-Fi 切换接入点时，她笔记本上的软电话会掉线。
call recording: Call recording on the advice line failed after the disk hit ninety percent.
磁盘用到百分之九十以后，咨询热线的通话录音就失败了。
IVR: IVR (Interactive Voice Response) still offers the old clinic hours from last winter.
IVR（语音导航）还在报去年冬天的旧门诊时间。
ACD: ACD (Automatic Call Distribution) sent the surge of calls to the overflow nurses.
ACD（自动呼叫分配）把突然增多的来电分给了溢出组护士。
queue wait: Queue wait on the main advice line passed four minutes during lunch.
午餐时段，主咨询线的排队等待超过了四分钟。
call drop: We saw a call drop every time the handoff crossed from closet two to three.
每次漫游从二号弱电间切到三号，我们都会看到通话中断。
codec: The codec on the new phones does not match the old ward gateway.
新话机的编解码和旧病区网关对不上。
jitter buffer: Raise the jitter buffer slightly if ICU calls keep sounding broken.
如果 ICU 的通话一直断断续续，就把抖动缓冲稍微加大。
QoS: QoS (Quality of Service) marks nurse-call traffic so a large file copy cannot drown it.
QoS（服务质量）给护士呼叫流量打标，大文件拷贝就不能把它淹没。
DSCP: We set DSCP (Differentiated Services Code Point) EF on the voice VLAN only.
我们只在语音 VLAN 上把 DSCP（差分服务标记）设成 EF。
traffic shaping: Traffic shaping on the guest link keeps streaming from crowding the clinic uplink.
访客链路上的流量整形，是为了不让视频流挤占门诊上联。
bandwidth cap: A bandwidth cap on the guest SSID stops one laptop from filling the link.
访客无线上的带宽上限能防止一台笔记本把链路占满。
WAN: The WAN (Wide Area Network) link to the east campus saturated during image transfers.
往东院区传图像时，WAN（广域网）链路被打满了。
LAN: The LAN (Local Area Network) in building C stayed up while the WAN link failed.
WAN 链路中断时，C 座的 LAN（局域网）仍然是通的。
MAN: Our MAN (Metropolitan Area Network) ties the three city campuses on hospital fiber.
我们的 MAN（城域网）用医院自己的光纤把市区三个院区连起来。
MPLS: MPLS (Multiprotocol Label Switching) carries the east campus traffic separate from internet.
MPLS（多协议标签交换）把东院区业务和上网流量分开承载。
SD-WAN: SD-WAN (Software-Defined Wide Area Network) moved clinic traffic to the backup circuit at noon.
中午 SD-WAN（软件定义广域网）把门诊流量切到了备用专线。
dark fiber: The dark fiber between the two campuses is ours, and the carrier only lights the path.
两院区之间的裸光纤是我们的，运营商只负责把光打通。
last mile: The last mile to the clinic annex is copper, and it fails whenever it rains.
到门诊附楼的最后一公里还是铜缆，一下雨就出故障。
circuit ID: Quote the circuit ID when you call the carrier about the east campus outage.
给运营商报东院区中断时，把专线编号一起报上。
carrier: The carrier swapped the failed fiber pair at the east campus handoff.
运营商在东院区的交接点换掉了那对故障光纤。
BGP: BGP (Border Gateway Protocol) dropped the east campus prefix for twelve minutes.
BGP（边界网关协议）把东院区前缀撤掉了十二分钟。
OSPF: OSPF (Open Shortest Path First) reconverged after the core link came back.
核心链路恢复后，OSPF（开放最短路径优先）重新收敛了。
static route: A static route on the lab firewall still points at the retired gateway.
实验室防火墙上有一条静态路由还指向已退役的网关。
default route: The default route vanished, so the ward could reach local servers but not mail.
默认路由没了，病区能访问本地服务器，但邮件不通。
routing table: The routing table on the clinic router has no path back to the lab.
门诊路由器的路由表里没有回检验网的路径。
ARP: ARP (Address Resolution Protocol) failed for the gateway, so every PC in the closet lost the network.
网关的 ARP（地址解析协议）失败了，弱电间里每台电脑都断了网。
ICMP: ICMP (Internet Control Message Protocol) is allowed to the gateway but blocked to the servers.
ICMP（网络控制消息）允许到网关，到服务器则被拦住。
TCP: TCP (Transmission Control Protocol) port 1433 to the HIS database is open from the app tier only.
只有应用层能访问 HIS 数据库的 TCP（传输控制协议）1433 端口。
UDP: UDP (User Datagram Protocol) 514 must reach the syslog server from every switch.
每台交换机都要把 UDP（用户数据报协议）514 送到日志服务器。
TLS: TLS (Transport Layer Security) on the patient portal still allows an old version.
患者门户的 TLS（传输层安全）还允许一个旧版本。
HTTPS: HTTPS (Hypertext Transfer Protocol Secure) is required on the patient portal now.
患者门户现在必须走 HTTPS（加密网页协议）。
HTTP: HTTP (Hypertext Transfer Protocol) on the old lab page redirects to the secure site.
旧检验页面的 HTTP（网页协议）会跳到加密站点。
FTP: FTP (File Transfer Protocol) to the instrument PC should close once the lab moves off it.
等检验迁走，仪器电脑上的 FTP（文件传输协议）就该关掉。
SFTP: SFTP (SSH File Transfer Protocol) is how the reference lab drops results each hour.
合作检验所每小时用 SFTP（安全文件传输）投递一次结果。
SMB: SMB (Server Message Block) signing is required before the file server returns to the ward.
文件服务器重新给病区用之前，必须打开 SMB（文件共享协议）签名。
NFS: NFS (Network File System) exports on the imaging archive are mounted read-only by the viewers.
影像归档上的 NFS（网络文件系统）导出，阅片端是只读挂载的。
CIFS: CIFS (Common Internet File System) shares from the old file server still feed two lab instruments.
旧文件服务器上的 CIFS（通用互联网文件系统）共享还在给两台检验仪器送数据。
RDP: RDP (Remote Desktop Protocol) to the jump host is the only path into the server VLAN.
进服务器 VLAN 只能走跳板机上的 RDP（远程桌面协议）。
SSH: SSH (Secure Shell) to the Linux archive works only from the admin jump host.
只有从管理跳板机才能用 SSH（安全外壳协议）连上 Linux 归档。
Telnet: Telnet is still enabled on that old lab switch, so turn it off today.
那台旧检验交换机上还开着 Telnet，今天把它关掉。
SNMP: SNMP (Simple Network Management Protocol) on the closet switches uses the new community string.
弱电间交换机上的 SNMP（简单网络管理）已经改用新的团体名。
Syslog server: Point every closet switch at the Syslog server before the change window starts.
变更窗口开始前，把每台弱电间交换机的日志指到日志服务器。
NTP server: If the NTP server is unreachable, badge readers and Kerberos both start failing.
时间服务器要是连不上，门禁读卡器和 Kerberos 都会开始失败。
time drift: Time drift on the lab PCs passed five minutes, and ticket logons began to fail.
实验室电脑的时间漂移超过五分钟后，票据登录开始失败。
clock skew: Clock skew between the two domain controllers broke logons in the east clinic.
两台域控制器之间的时钟偏差，让东门诊登录失败了。
Kerberos: Kerberos rejected the lab PCs because their clocks were six minutes fast.
实验室电脑的时钟快了六分钟，Kerberos 把它们拒绝了。
NTLM: NTLM (NT LAN Manager) is still required by one old instrument in microbiology.
微生物室有一台旧仪器还要求用 NTLM（Windows认证）。
token cache: Clear the token cache on her PC if the new group rights still do not apply.
如果新的组权限还没生效，就清掉她电脑上的令牌缓存。
ticket-granting: The ticket-granting service was down, so nobody in the clinic could get a new ticket.
票据授予服务停了，门诊里没人能拿到新票据。
service principal: The service principal for the lab app is missing a secret, so sign-in fails.
检验应用的服务主体少了一把密钥，登录因此失败。
SPN: The SPN (Service Principal Name) for the HIS database was registered on the wrong account.
HIS 数据库的 SPN（服务主体名称）注册到了错误的账号上。
GPO: This GPO (Group Policy Object) turns on the screen lock after ten idle minutes.
这条 GPO（组策略对象）会在空闲十分钟后锁定屏幕。
OU: Move the new scanners into the clinic OU (Organizational Unit) before policy applies.
策略套用前，把新扫描仪移进门诊 OU（组织单元）。
security group: Add her to the security group that can open the pharmacy share.
把她加进能打开药房共享的那个安全组。
distribution group: Mail to the distribution group for charge nurses never reached the night shift.
发给责任护士通讯组的邮件没有送到夜班。
nested group: A nested group hid her access, so the pharmacy share denied her this morning.
嵌套组把她的权限藏住了，今天早上药房共享拒绝了她。
group membership: Her group membership changed at noon, but the old token lasts until she signs in again.
她的组成员关系中午改了，但旧令牌要等她重新登录才失效。
sid: The sid on this cloned PC matches another machine, so domain join fails.
这台克隆电脑的安全标识和另一台机器重复，加域因此失败。
GUID: The GUID (Globally Unique Identifier) on the duplicated policy made the second copy fail to link.
复制出来的策略带着同一个 GUID（全局唯一标识），第二份因此链接不上。
UPN: Her UPN (User Principal Name) still uses the old hospital domain after the rename.
域名改完之后，她的 UPN（用户主体名称）还是旧的医院域名。
sAMAccountName: The sAMAccountName cannot exceed twenty characters or the old lab app rejects it.
登录名不能超过二十个字符，否则旧检验程序会拒绝。
password hash: Never copy a password hash into a ticket or a chat with the vendor.
不要把密码哈希写进工单，也不要发到和厂商的聊天里。
salt: A unique salt on each password hash keeps identical passwords from looking alike.
每个密码哈希都有独立加盐，相同的密码看起来也不会一样。
hash: Check the hash on the vendor installer before it goes on any clinic PC.
厂商安装包装到任何门诊电脑之前，先核对哈希。
encryption key: The encryption key for the archive left with the old admin and nobody else has it.
归档的加密密钥跟着老管理员走了，别人手里都没有。
public key: Publish the public key for the results mailbox so partner labs can encrypt files.
把结果邮箱的公钥公布出去，合作检验所才能加密文件。
private key: The private key for the portal certificate never leaves the application server.
门户证书的私钥不能离开应用服务器。
certificate chain: The certificate chain is missing the intermediate, so browsers warn on the portal.

问厂商这个补丁为什么把打印弄坏时，把知识库编号一起报上。
reboot pending: Reboot pending has been set on the pharmacy PC since Tuesday's patch.
从周二的补丁起，药房电脑就一直是等待重启。
pending reboot: A pending reboot is blocking further patches on the registration PCs.
待重启状态挡住了挂号电脑上后面的补丁。
WUAgent: WUAgent on the clinic image is pointed at our update server, not the public one.
门诊镜像里的更新代理指向我们自己的更新服务器，不是公网那台。
WSUS: WSUS (Windows Server Update Services) approved the May rollup for the clinic PCs only.
WSUS（补丁分发服务器）只给门诊电脑批准了五月的累积包。
catalog file: The catalog file for this offline patch did not match the package we downloaded.
这个离线补丁的目录文件和我们下到的安装包对不上。
offline patch: Use the offline patch on the isolated lab host that cannot reach the update server.
那台连不上更新服务器的隔离检验主机，用离线补丁来打。
online update: An online update on the guest network pulled a driver the clinic image does not want.
访客网络上的一次在线更新拉来了门诊镜像不想要的驱动。
metered network: The cellular failover is a metered network, so large updates wait until fiber returns.
蜂窝备用线路是按流量计费的网络，大更新会等到光纤恢复再下。
delivery optimization: Delivery optimization let nearby clinic PCs share the May update instead of each pulling it.
分发优化让旁边的门诊电脑互相传五月的更新，不用各自去拉。
peer cache: Peer cache on the ward subnet served the viewer package to PCs that missed the push.
病区子网的对等缓存把阅片安装包给了没接到推送的电脑。
branch cache: Branch cache at the east campus kept the policy files local after the WAN blip.
广域网抖了一下之后，东院区的分支缓存仍把策略文件留在本地。
content server: The content server in building C holds the viewer package for that campus.
C 座的内容服务器放着这个院区的阅片安装包。
distribution point: The distribution point at the east campus ran out of disk during the viewer push.
推送阅片程序的时候，东院区分发点的磁盘用完了。
management point: Clients at the annex cannot find a management point, so they never pick up policy.
附楼的客户端找不到管理点，所以一直拿不到策略。
client agent: The client agent on the pharmacy PC stopped reporting after yesterday's patch.
昨天的补丁之后，药房电脑上的客户端代理停止上报了。
heartbeat interval: Shorten the heartbeat interval if you need faster notice when a clinic PC drops.
如果希望门诊电脑掉线时更快知道，就把心跳间隔缩短。
policy refresh: Policy refresh on the ward PCs picked up the new screen-lock setting within the hour.
病区电脑的策略刷新在一小时内拿到了新的锁屏设置。
gpupdate: Sign in to the nurse station and gpupdate after the password policy changes.
密码策略改完之后，登录护士站电脑并刷新组策略。
rsop: Run rsop (Resultant Set of Policy) if the clinic screen lock is not applying.
如果门诊电脑的锁屏没生效，就跑一下 rsop（策略结果集）。
event forwarding: Event forwarding from the ward PCs stopped when the collector certificate expired.
收集器证书过期后，病区电脑的事件转发停了。
WEF: WEF (Windows Event Forwarding) is how we collect logon failures from every ward PC.
我们靠 WEF（Windows事件转发）从每台病区电脑收集登录失败。
collector: The collector filled its disk and stopped accepting forwarded security events.
事件收集器磁盘满了，不再收转发来的安全事件。
subscription: This subscription collects only failed logons, not every process start on the ward.
这个订阅只收登录失败，不收病区上每一次进程启动。
query filter: Tighten the query filter or the collector will drown in process-start events.
把查询过滤收紧，不然事件收集器会被进程启动事件淹没。
xpath: The xpath in this subscription keeps failed logons and drops the rest.
这个订阅里的路径查询只留下登录失败，其余都丢掉。
event ID: Filter on event ID 4625 if you want only the failed logons from last night.
如果只要昨晚的登录失败，就按事件编号 4625 过滤。
logon type: Logon type 3 on those events means a network logon, not someone at the keyboard.
那些事件里的登录类型 3 是网络登录，不是有人坐在键盘前。
privileged logon: A privileged logon from a clinic PC at 02:00 is worth a closer look.
凌晨两点从一台门诊电脑发起的特权登录，值得再看一眼。
explicit creds: Explicit creds were used for that admin logon, so it was not a stolen ticket.
那次管理员登录用的是显式凭据，不是一张被偷走的票据。
pass-the-hash: Pass-the-hash from the compromised kiosk reached a file server in the same VLAN.
从失陷查询机发起的哈希传递，碰到了同一 VLAN 里的文件服务器。
kerberoasting: Kerberoasting against the HIS service account showed up in last night's authentication logs.
昨晚的认证日志里出现了针对 HIS 服务账号的票据攻击手法。
lateral movement: Lateral movement from the lobby PC reached the file server within twenty minutes.
从大厅那台电脑开始的横向移动，二十分钟内就到了文件服务器。
living off the land: Living off the land let the attacker use PowerShell already installed on the ward PC.
对方利用系统自带工具，用上了病区电脑里已经装着的 PowerShell。
IOC: This IOC (Indicator of Compromise) matches a file we found on two registration PCs.
这个 IOC（失陷指标）和我们在两台挂号电脑上找到的文件对得上。
IOA: That IOA (Indicator of Attack) is the sequence of a credential dump, not a single file.
那个 IOA（攻击行为指标）是一串凭据转储动作，不是单个文件。
threat intel: Threat intel from the peer hospital named the same sender we saw this morning.
兄弟医院的威胁情报点名的发件人，和我们今早看到的是同一个。
indicator: That file hash is an indicator from the phishing wave that hit clinics in May.
那个文件哈希是五月打到门诊的那波钓鱼里的一个威胁指标。
hash reputation: Hash reputation for this installer is unknown, so do not run it on a clinic PC.
这个安装包的哈希信誉未知，不要在门诊电脑上运行。
file hash: Send me the file hash of the viewer build before it is pushed to the ward.
阅片构建推到病区之前，先把文件哈希发给我。
SHA-256: SHA-256 (Secure Hash Algorithm 256) of the installer matches the value on the vendor site.
安装包的 SHA-256（哈希算法）和厂商网站上的值一致。
MD5: MD5 (Message Digest 5) is too weak for new packages, so ask the vendor for SHA-256.
MD5（旧哈希算法）对新安装包来说太弱，向厂商要 SHA-256。
quarantine: Quarantine the installer that Defender flagged before anyone on the ward runs it.
病区有人运行之前，先把系统防护标出的那个安装包隔离掉。
allow exception: An allow exception for that signed viewer lets it run where the whitelist would block it.
给那个已签名的阅片程序加一条放行例外，白名单本会拦住的地方它就能跑。
block hash: A block hash stopped the known bad installer on every managed clinic PC.
按哈希拦截在每台受管门诊电脑上挡住了那个已知的坏安装包。
block path: The block path rule stops anything launched from the user download folder.
按路径拦截会阻止从用户下载目录启动的任何程序。
block publisher: The block publisher rule stopped the untrusted toolbar that came with a printer driver.
按发布者拦截挡住了随打印驱动一起进来的那个不受信任工具栏。
code signing: Code signing on the viewer lets the whitelist trust it without a path exception.
阅片程序有代码签名，白名单就可以信任它，不必再加路径例外。
unsigned binary: An unsigned binary in the temp folder tried to start on the registration PC.
挂号电脑的临时目录里有一个未签名程序试图启动。
trusted publisher: Add the viewer vendor as a trusted publisher so updates install without a prompt.
把阅片厂商加为受信任发布者，更新就可以不再弹提示。
SmartScreen: SmartScreen warned on the dictation installer because the download was rare.
这个听写安装包很少有人下，智能筛选因此弹了警告。
Defender: Defender quarantined the installer on the registration PC before anyone opened it.
有人打开之前，系统防护已经隔离了挂号电脑上的那个安装包。
ASR: ASR (Attack Surface Reduction) blocked Office from creating a child process on the billing PC.
ASR（攻击面减少）阻止了收费电脑上的 Office 拉起子进程。
exploit protection: Exploit protection on the billing PC blocked a memory exploit against the old reader.
收费电脑上的漏洞利用防护拦住了一次针对旧读卡程序的内存利用。
DEP: DEP (Data Execution Prevention) stopped the old viewer when it tried to run a data page.
旧阅片程序试图把数据页当代码跑的时候，DEP（数据执行保护）把它拦住了。
ASLR: ASLR (Address Space Layout Randomization) is on, so the old exploit misses its target address.
ASLR（地址随机化）开着，旧的利用代码打不中目标地址。
Control Flow Guard: Control Flow Guard stopped the call into an unexpected address inside the viewer.
控制流防护拦住了阅片程序里一次跳向意外地址的调用。
WDAC: WDAC (Windows Defender Application Control) allows only signed binaries on the kiosk image.
WDAC（应用控制）只允许查询机镜像运行已签名程序。
AppLocker: AppLocker stopped the user from running a portable browser out of Downloads.
应用锁阻止用户从下载目录运行便携版浏览器。
Software Restriction: Software Restriction on the kiosk blocks executables that are not under Program Files.
查询机上的软件限制策略会拦截不在 Program Files 里的可执行文件。
Device Guard: Device Guard on the kiosk image refuses any kernel driver we have not signed.
查询机镜像上的设备防护会拒绝我们没有签名的内核驱动。
Credential Guard: Credential Guard kept the stolen process from reading hashes out of memory.
凭据防护让那个被盗用的进程读不到内存里的哈希。
LSA protection: LSA protection is enabled, so untrusted tools cannot read credentials from that process.
认证进程保护已经打开，不受信任的工具读不到那个进程里的凭据。
secure boot: Secure boot stopped the host because the bootloader signature did not match.
安全启动拦住了这台主机，因为引导程序签名对不上。
measured boot: Measured boot recorded a firmware change, and the host asked for the recovery key.
度量启动记录到固件变了，主机于是索要恢复密钥。
TPM: The TPM (Trusted Platform Module) on this laptop failed, so disk unlock now asks for the key.
这台笔记本的 TPM（可信平台模块）坏了，磁盘解锁现在会要密钥。
PCR: A firmware change moved PCR (Platform Configuration Register) 7, so the PIN no longer matches.
固件一改，PCR（平台配置寄存器）7 变了，开机密码就对不上。
BitLocker recovery: She is locked out and needs the BitLocker recovery key from the escrow console.
她进不了系统，得从密钥托管控制台拿磁盘恢复密钥。
recovery key: Write down the recovery key before this laptop leaves for the offsite clinic.
这台笔记本送去院外门诊之前，先把恢复密钥抄下来。
TPM owner: Nobody knows the TPM owner password, so we cannot clear the module without a wipe.
没人知道可信模块属主密码，不擦数据就清不了这块模块。
escrow: Put the new recovery key into escrow before the laptop goes to the ward.
笔记本送到病区之前，先把新的恢复密钥放进密钥托管。
MBAM: MBAM (Microsoft BitLocker Administration and Monitoring) stores recovery keys for every nursing laptop.
MBAM（磁盘加密管理）存着每台护理笔记本的恢复密钥。
disk unlock: Disk unlock failed on her laptop because the TPM saw a firmware change.
她笔记本的磁盘解锁失败了，因为可信模块发现固件变过。
pre-boot: Pre-boot asks for the PIN before Windows loads, so a stolen laptop stays sealed.
开机前验证会在 Windows 加载前索要密码，偷走的笔记本因此打不开盘。
BitLocker PIN: She forgot the BitLocker PIN, so the laptop stopped at the pre-boot screen.
她忘了磁盘开机密码，笔记本停在开机前的界面上。
startup key: The startup key lives on a USB stick that must be plugged in before this kiosk boots.
启动密钥在一个 U 盘上，这台查询机开机前必须插着它。
USB key: This kiosk will not pass pre-boot unless the USB key is plugged into the front port.
U 盘密钥不插在前面的口上，这台查询机就过不了开机前验证。
network unlock: Network unlock let the desktop boot without a PIN because it could see the key server.
这台台式机能看到密钥服务器，网络解锁让它不用密码就启动了。
protector: The only protector left on this disk is the recovery password, not the TPM.
这块盘上只剩恢复密码这一个保护器，没有可信模块。
numerical password: Read the numerical password in groups of six so she can type it at the pre-boot screen.
把数字恢复密码按六位一组读给她，她才能在开机前界面输入。
FIPS: FIPS (Federal Information Processing Standards) mode is required on laptops that leave the campus.
带出院区的笔记本必须打开 FIPS（联邦加密标准）模式。
HSM: The HSM (Hardware Security Module) holds the root key, and the application servers never see it.
HSM（硬件安全模块）保管着根密钥，应用服务器始终看不到它。
KMS: KMS (Key Management Service) wrapped the data key so the database file stays encrypted at rest.
KMS（密钥管理服务）包住了数据密钥，数据库文件在落盘后仍是加密的。
CMK: The CMK (Customer Master Key) for the archive never leaves the hardware module.
归档用的 CMK（客户主密钥）始终不离开硬件模块。
envelope encryption: Envelope encryption wraps the data key with the master key so we can rotate one without rewriting files.
信封加密用主密钥包住数据密钥，这样轮换其中一把就不用重写文件。
data key: The data key encrypts the archive file, and the master key encrypts that data key.
数据密钥负责加密归档文件，主密钥再去加密这把数据密钥。
key alias: Point the app at the key alias so we can rotate the key without a config change.
让应用指向密钥别名，轮换密钥时就不用改配置。
key policy: The key policy lets the archive role encrypt and denies everyone else.
密钥策略允许归档角色做加密，其他人一律拒绝。
key deletion: Key deletion is scheduled for seven days from now, so we can still cancel it.
密钥删除排在七天之后，现在还取消得了。
key disable: After key disable, that archive key can no longer encrypt new files.
密钥停用之后，那把归档密钥不能再加密新文件。
key enable: After key enable, the archive key accepted new writes again.
密钥启用之后，归档密钥又能接受新的写入了。
cryptographic erase: Cryptographic erase destroys the media key, and the leftover bits become unreadable.
加密擦除毁掉介质密钥之后，盘上剩下的数据就读不出来了。
secure wipe: A secure wipe of the retired PC takes hours, so start it before the pickup.
退役电脑的安全擦除要好几个小时，来收机器之前就开始。
disk wipe: The disk wipe on that retired array finished overnight and the drives are ready to leave.
那套退役阵列的磁盘擦除夜里做完了，硬盘可以拿走了。
degauss: Degauss the old backup tapes before they leave the records room.
旧备份磁带离开病案室之前，先消磁。
physical destruction: Physical destruction is required for drives that failed a wipe and still spin up.
擦除失败但还能转起来的硬盘，必须做物理销毁。
media sanitization: Media sanitization for the retired array has to finish before the vendor takes the disks.
厂商把盘拿走之前，退役阵列的介质净化必须做完。
NIST wipe: Use a NIST wipe on drives that will be reused inside the hospital.
医院内部还要继续用的硬盘，按标准擦除来做。
DoD wipe: A DoD wipe takes longer, so reserve it for drives that stored patient identifiers.
国防部擦除更花时间，留给存过患者标识的硬盘。
spare disk: Keep a spare disk of the same size on the shelf beside the imaging array.
在影像阵列旁边的架子上留一块同样大小的备用磁盘。
hot spare: The hot spare took over within a minute after disk three dropped out of the set.
三号盘掉出阵列后，热备盘在一分钟内接上了。
cold spare: The cold spare is on the shelf, so someone has to seat it before the rebuild starts.
冷备盘在架子上，得有人把它装进去，重建才会开始。
rebuild time: Rebuild time on this wide set is about a day, so leave the hot spare assigned.
这么宽的一组盘，重建时间大约一天，热备盘先别拆。
degraded array: The degraded array is still serving images, but a second disk failure would stop it.
降级阵列还在出图像，但再坏一块盘它就会停。
failed disk: Pull the failed disk from slot four only after the hot spare has finished rebuilding.
等热备盘重建完，再从四号槽拔出故障磁盘。
predictive failure: Predictive failure on disk two means we should replace it before the array degrades.
二号盘已经预警故障，应该在阵列降级之前把它换掉。
SMART: SMART (Self-Monitoring, Analysis and Reporting Technology) flagged disk two a week before it failed.
SMART（磁盘健康监测）在二号盘坏掉前一周就报了警。
bad sector: A growing bad sector count on disk five is why that virtual disk feels slow.
五号盘的坏扇区越来越多，那块虚拟磁盘因此变慢。
uncorrectable error: An uncorrectable error on disk five means the array can no longer repair that block.
五号盘出现不可纠正错误，阵列已经修不好那个块了。
reallocated sector: The reallocated sector count on disk five jumped overnight, so order a replacement.
五号盘的重映射扇区计数夜里跳了一截，去订一块替换盘。
spin-up: Spin-up of the archive shelves takes almost a minute after the nightly idle.
夜间休眠之后，归档盘柜的磁盘启动差不多要一分钟。
head crash: A head crash on that old shelf destroyed the only copy of the 2014 studies.
那个旧盘柜磁头损坏，把 2014 年检查的唯一副本毁了。
SSD: Put the database on SSD (Solid State Drive) and leave the bulk images on spinning disks.
数据库放在 SSD（固态硬盘）上，大批影像仍放在机械盘上。
HDD: The HDD (Hard Disk Drive) in the archive shelf is louder and slower than the new flash tier.
归档柜里的 HDD（机械硬盘）比新的闪存层更吵，也更慢。
NVMe: NVMe (Non-Volatile Memory Express) on the database host made log writes several times faster.
数据库主机上的 NVMe（高速固态接口）让日志写入快了好几倍。
SATA: The SATA (Serial ATA) bay in this old host is too slow for the database logs.
这台旧主机上的 SATA（串口硬盘接口）盘位对数据库日志来说太慢。
SAS: Use SAS (Serial Attached SCSI) disks in the array; the SATA bay is only for the boot device.
阵列里用 SAS（服务器硬盘接口）盘，SATA 盘位只留给启动盘。
M.2: The M.2 boot drive on this host is loose, and the server drops into setup.
这台主机的 M.2 启动盘松了，服务器会掉进设置界面。
hot swap: Hot swap let us replace disk four while the imaging array kept serving studies.
靠热插拔，我们在影像阵列继续提供检查的同时换掉了四号盘。
caddy: Seat the replacement disk in the caddy before you slide it into bay four.
先把替换盘固定进硬盘托架，再推进四号盘位。
backplane: Two bays on the backplane stopped seeing disks after we reseated the cable.
线重新插过之后，硬盘背板上有两个盘位不再认盘。
RAID controller: The RAID controller battery is dead, so the array fell back to write-through.
阵列卡的电池没电了，阵列退回到直写。
battery backup unit: Replace the battery backup unit so the array can turn write-back on again.
把阵列电池换掉，阵列才能重新打开回写。
write cache: Write cache on the array is disabled until the battery holds a charge again.
电池重新蓄上电之前，阵列的写缓存一直关着。
read cache: Read cache on the array is serving the same study films to several viewers.
阵列的读缓存正在把同一份检查影像同时给好几台阅片端。
cache battery: The cache battery failed its test, and the array switched itself to write-through.
缓存电池自检没过，阵列自己切到了直写。
write-through: Write-through is slower, but a power loss cannot strand data that was only in cache.
直写更慢，但停电不会把只待在缓存里的数据弄丢。
write-back: Write-back is safe again now that the cache battery holds a full charge.
缓存电池已经充满，回写又安全了。
stripe: Each stripe spreads one write across all six disks in the imaging set.
每一条条带都把一次写入分到影像组的六块盘上。
mirror: The mirror still has a full copy, so the array survived the loss of disk two.
镜像盘上还有完整副本，所以丢了二号盘阵列也撑住了。
parity: Parity on this set can rebuild one missing disk, but not two at once.
这组盘的校验能重建一块丢失的盘，不能同时重建两块。
RAID 1: RAID 1 keeps a second copy of the database logs on the paired disk.
镜像阵列在配对盘上留着数据库日志的第二份。
RAID 5: RAID 5 on the file server can lose one disk and still serve the ward shares.
文件服务器上的校验阵列可以坏一块盘，病区共享仍然能用。
RAID 6: RAID 6 survived two failed disks in the archive, and the studies stayed online.
归档上的双校验阵列扛住了两块故障盘，检查仍然在线。
RAID 10: RAID 10 mirrors each pair and then stripes across those pairs for the database.
镜像条带先镜像每一对盘，再在这些盘对上做条带，给数据库用。
JBOD: JBOD (Just a Bunch of Disks) on that shelf has no parity, so one disk loss is permanent.
那个盘柜上的 JBOD（简单磁盘组合）没有校验，坏一块盘数据就没了。
thin provision: Thin provision let us assign more space than the pool holds, so watch the free capacity.
精简配置让我们划出的空间超过了池子实有容量，所以要盯着剩余空间。
thick provision: Thick provision reserved the full disk up front, so this database cannot be starved later.
厚配置一开始就占满了整块空间，这个数据库以后不会被挤掉容量。
overcommit: Do not overcommit storage on the pool that holds the HIS database.
存放 HIS 数据库的那个存储池不要超分。
storage pool: The storage pool for images is down to eight percent free after the weekend studies.
周末的检查做完，影像存储池的剩余空间只剩百分之八。
datastore: The datastore that holds the HIS disks is the one running low on free space.
放 HIS 磁盘的那个数据存储，就是剩余空间见底的那个。
VMDK: The VMDK (Virtual Machine Disk) for the HIS data disk grew past the datastore free space.
HIS 数据盘的 VMDK（虚拟磁盘文件）已经长过数据存储的剩余空间。
VHD: The VHD (Virtual Hard Disk) for that lab VM sits on a volume that is nearly full.
那台检验虚拟机的 VHD（虚拟硬盘）放在一个快满的卷上。
snapshot chain: The snapshot chain on the HIS VM is six levels deep and slowing every write.
HIS 虚拟机的快照链已经六层，每次写入都变慢。
delta disk: The delta disk from last week's snapshot is larger than the base disk now.
上周快照留下的增量盘，现在比基础盘还大。
linked clone: A linked clone of the training VM shares the base disk and only stores changes.
培训虚拟机的链接克隆和基础盘共用空间，只另外存变更。
full clone: A full clone of the HIS VM copies every block and can move to another datastore.
HIS 虚拟机的完整克隆会复制每一个块，也能迁到别的数据存储。
template VM: Deploy each clinic desktop from the template VM so every desk starts from the same build.
每台门诊桌面都从虚拟机模板部署，每个工位的起点才是同一套构建。
instant clone: An instant clone of the training desktop was ready before the class sat down.
上课入座之前，培训桌面的即时克隆就已经好了。
vMotion: vMotion moved the HIS VM off the failing host without dropping the clinic sessions.
在线迁移把 HIS 虚拟机挪离了那台故障主机，门诊会话没有断。
storage vMotion: Storage vMotion is moving the HIS disks onto the new array while users stay connected.
存储在线迁移正在把 HIS 磁盘迁到新阵列，用户保持连接。
HA cluster: The HA cluster restarted the HIS VM on another host after host two died.
二号主机宕了之后，高可用集群在另一台主机上把 HIS 虚拟机拉了起来。
DRS: DRS (Distributed Resource Scheduler) moved a noisy lab VM off the host that runs HIS.
DRS（动态资源调度）把一台抢资源的检验虚拟机挪离了跑 HIS 的主机。
affinity: Set affinity so the database VM stays on the same host as its log VM.
设好亲和性，让数据库虚拟机和它的日志虚拟机留在同一台主机。
anti-affinity: Anti-affinity keeps the two domain controllers on different hosts.
反亲和性让两台域控制器跑在不同的主机上。
resource pool: The resource pool for lab VMs is capped so they cannot starve the HIS host.
实验室虚拟机的资源池加了上限，免得把 HIS 那台主机的资源吃光。
reservation: Set a memory reservation on the HIS VM so ballooning cannot reclaim it.
给 HIS 虚拟机设内存资源预留，内存回收就收不走这部分。
limit: The CPU limit on the lab VM is why that test build runs so slowly.
实验室虚拟机的处理器资源上限，就是那个测试构建这么慢的原因。
shares: Raise the CPU shares for the pharmacy VM during the morning dispensing peak.
早晨发药高峰时，把药房虚拟机的处理器资源份额调高。
ballooning: Ballooning on host two started when the lab VMs grabbed the free memory.
实验室虚拟机把空闲内存抢走之后，二号主机上的内存回收开始了。
swap file: The swap file for the HIS VM grew when the host ran out of physical memory.
主机物理内存用尽时，HIS 虚拟机的交换文件变大了。
CPU ready: CPU ready on the HIS VM climbed at 09:00, and the clinic screens lagged.
09:00 时 HIS 虚拟机的处理器等待升高，门诊界面开始卡。
co-stop: Co-stop spiked because the wide HIS VM could not schedule all its processors together.
共同停顿飙高了，因为那台处理器很多的 HIS 虚拟机没法同时排上全部处理器。
NUMA: NUMA (Non-Uniform Memory Access) alignment matters on the wide HIS VM, or memory latency jumps.
处理器很多的 HIS 虚拟机必须对齐 NUMA（内存亲和架构），否则内存延迟会跳上去。
vCPU: The lab VM has eight vCPU and spends the morning waiting to be scheduled.
实验室虚拟机有八个虚拟处理器，一上午都在等着被调度。
vRAM: Give the HIS VM more vRAM before month-end reporting or it will swap.
月末出报表之前给 HIS 虚拟机加虚拟内存，否则它会开始交换。
guest OS: The guest OS on the lab VM is still the old build the vendor refuses to support.
实验室虚拟机里的客户机系统还是厂商已经不支持的旧版本。
host OS: Patch the host OS only after the HIS VM has moved to the other node.
等 HIS 虚拟机迁到另一台节点，再给宿主机系统打补丁。
tools agent: The tools agent inside the HIS VM is two versions behind, so clean shutdown fails.
HIS 虚拟机里的虚拟化工具代理落后两个版本，正常关机因此失败。
guest customization: Guest customization set the clinic hostname and joined the desktop to the domain.
客户机定制写好了门诊主机名，并把这台桌面加入了域。
sysprep: Run sysprep on the reference PC before you capture the clinic image.
抓门诊镜像之前，先在参考电脑上做系统封装。
SID duplication: SID duplication on the cloned PCs made domain join fail for the whole clinic row.
克隆电脑的安全标识重复，整排门诊机器加域都失败了。
IP conflict: An IP conflict appeared when two label printers came up with the same address.
两台标签打印机带着同一个地址起来，地址冲突就出现了。
duplicate MAC: A duplicate MAC on the cloned VM made the switch flap the pharmacy port.
克隆虚拟机的网卡地址重复，交换机把药房那个端口打得一直抖。
promiscuous mode: Promiscuous mode is enabled on the sensor port group and nowhere else.
混杂模式只开在传感器那个端口组上，别处都没有。
forged transmit: Leave forged transmit blocked so a guest VM cannot send with another host's address.
伪造发送继续保持拦截，客户机就不能冒用别的主机地址发包。
MAC change: MAC change is rejected on the clinic port group, so a VM cannot spoof its neighbor.
门诊端口组拒绝网卡地址更改，虚拟机就不能伪装成旁边那一台。
port group: Put the pharmacy phones on the voice port group, not the PC port group.
药房电话放进语音端口组，不要放进电脑端口组。
virtual switch: The virtual switch for the server VLAN lost its uplink when the physical NIC died.
物理网卡一坏，服务器 VLAN 的虚拟交换机就失去了上联。
uplink NIC: The uplink NIC on host two is down, and every VM there lost the server VLAN.
二号主机的上联网卡断了，上面每台虚拟机都掉出了服务器 VLAN。
NIC teaming: NIC teaming kept the host online when one physical port on the rack switch died.
机柜交换机有一个物理口坏了，网卡绑定仍让主机保持在线。
LACP: LACP (Link Aggregation Control Protocol) on the host uplinks needs the matching channel on the switch.
主机上联如果做了 LACP（链路聚合），交换机上必须有对应的通道。
load balance: The load balance across the two uplinks is uneven, and one port is near full.
两条上联之间的负载分担不均，有一个口已经接近打满。
failover order: The failover order uses the 10-gig port first and the 1-gig port only as backup.
故障切换顺序先用万兆口，千兆口只作备用。
beacon probing: Beacon probing marked the uplink failed even though the switch port still showed link.
交换机口还显示链路是通的，信标探测却把上联标成了故障。
network isolation: Network isolation put the infected registration PC on a VLAN with no routes out.
网络隔离把那台中招的挂号电脑放进了一个出不去的 VLAN。
microsegmentation: Microsegmentation stops the pharmacy VLAN from talking to the imaging archive directly.
微分段不让药房 VLAN 直接和影像归档通信。
distributed firewall: The distributed firewall drops lab traffic that tries to reach the medical-record subnet.
分布式防火墙会丢掉试图进入病历子网的检验流量。
east-west traffic: East-west traffic between the app tier and the database never leaves the host.
应用层和数据库之间的东西向流量始终不离开这台主机。
north-south traffic: North-south traffic from the clinics to the portal passes the perimeter firewall.
门诊到门户的南北向流量会经过边界防火墙。
hairpin: Hairpin on the firewall sends the return path back out the same clinic link.
防火墙上的回流转发把回程从同一条门诊链路送回去。
anycast: Anycast lets every campus reach the nearest DNS resolver with the same address.
任播让每个院区用同一个地址访问离自己最近的 DNS 解析器。
unicast: Unicast is how the HIS app reaches one database host, not the whole subnet.
HIS 应用访问某一台数据库主机靠的是单播，不是对整个子网说话。
multicast: Multicast carries the nurse-call alerts, so a missing querier silenced a whole floor.
护士呼叫告警走组播，查询器一缺，整层楼就没了声音。
broadcast: A broadcast from the bad printer NIC filled the clinic VLAN within a minute.
那块坏掉的打印机网卡发出的广播，一分钟内灌满了门诊 VLAN。
IGMP: IGMP (Internet Group Management Protocol) snooping stopped the nurse-call flood from reaching every port.
IGMP（组播管理协议）侦听拦住了护士呼叫的泛洪，没有让它冲到每个端口。
protocol independent multicast: Protocol independent multicast builds the tree that carries nurse-call video between closets.
协议无关组播建好了树，护士呼叫的视频才在各个弱电间之间传送。
mDNS: mDNS (Multicast DNS) from a personal printer answered names that belong to the hospital.
一台个人打印机发出的 mDNS（组播域名）应答了本属于医院的名称。
LLMNR: LLMNR (Link-Local Multicast Name Resolution) is disabled on clinic PCs so a rogue host cannot answer.
门诊电脑上关了 LLMNR（本地链路名称解析），冒充的主机就不能抢答名称。
NetBIOS: NetBIOS name queries are still leaking on the clinic VLAN from old label printers.
旧标签打印机还在门诊 VLAN 上泄漏网上基本输入输出的名称查询。
WINS: WINS (Windows Internet Name Service) is still required by one old instrument that cannot use DNS.
有一台不能用 DNS 的旧仪器，仍然需要 WINS（Windows名称服务）。
name resolution: Name resolution for the lab server failed on the ward, but the raw address still worked.
病区上检验服务器的名称解析失败了，但直接用地址仍然能通。
split-brain DNS: Split-brain DNS gives staff the internal portal address and guests the public one.
脑裂域名给员工内部门户地址，给外来访客公网地址。
conditional forwarder: The conditional forwarder sends partner-lab names to their DNS and keeps ours local.
条件转发把合作检验所的名称送到他们的 DNS，我们自己的名称仍在本地解析。
stub zone: The stub zone for the partner lab holds only the list of their name servers.
合作检验所的存根区域里只放着他们域名服务器的名单。
